text: Finds and fixes known vulnerabilities in open-source libraries used by an application
quote: Snyk Open Source allows you to find and fix vulnerabilities in the open-source libraries used by your applications.

text: Static application security testing that scans source code in real time across IDEs, repos, and CI/CD

text: Visualizes the vulnerable data flow from source to sink step-by-step
quote: Visualize the path of the issue from source to sink with a step-by-step flow.

text: Computes a single risk score for issues based on prevalence, ease of fix, and other risk factors to prioritize them
quote: Sort by and prioritize the more important issues by incorporating factors such as issue prevalence, ease of fix, and risk factor into a single risk score.

text: Lets users ignore/suppress specific issues so they no longer generate warnings
quote: Configure Snyk to ignore suggested fixes for an issue to suppress specific warnings.

text: Tracks and exports Snyk issues into a Jira project
quote: Track and export Snyk issues to your Jira project.

text: Scans container images to find and fix OS and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploy
quote: Snyk Container provides tools and integrations to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities. This allows you to create images that have security built-in from the start.

text: Scans IaC configs (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, ARM) for security misconfigurations across IDE, SCM, CLI and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise
quote: Write secure configurations for HashiCorp Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Kubernetes, and Azure Resource Manager (ARM) - for IDE, SCM, CLI, and Terraform Cloud/Enterprise workflows.

text: Detects manually created (drifted) cloud resources not managed by IaC
quote: Detect manually created resources in your cloud.

text: Official CLI can be run locally, inside an IDE, or as part of a CI/CD pipeline
quote: You can run the CLI locally from the command line or in an IDE. You can also run the CLI in your CI/CD pipeline.

text: Snyk Studio provides hooks in agentic dev environments so AI-generated code is secure at inception
quote: Snyk Studio supports a default hooks-based approach for some agentic development environments (ADEs) to ensure code written by AI coding assistants is secure at inception (SAI)

text: MCP server setup can be validated by prompting a coding agent in natural language to scan a directory
quote: To validate the MCP server configuration, prompt your coding agent with natural language, for example, "scan my directory for security issues".

text: An LLM-driven Remediation Agent scans a project, builds a fix plan, applies fixes, and verifies the result automatically

text: CLI command 'snyk fix --agentic' runs a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation flow from the terminal
quote: Snyk CLI: Run `snyk fix --agentic` from your terminal to trigger a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience without an IDE.

text: DeepCode AI provides automated code fixes claimed to be 85% accurate
quote: DeepCode AI powers 85%-accurate security autofixes and comprehensive app coverage, letting developers build fast while staying secure.

text: Users can write custom queries in DeepCode AI logic with autocomplete to find matches in code
quote: Write your own queries using DeepCode AI logic (with autocomplete) and leverage the hybrid AI to instantly find matches in your code.

text: Scans indirect/transitive open-source dependencies for vulnerabilities, not just direct ones

text: Scans dependencies for license compliance against known license policies
quote: Snyk Open Source can also scan your Projects for license compliance, checking against licenses known to Snyk.

text: Provides actionable fix advice and supports fixing vulnerabilities via pull requests
quote: Snyk provides actionable fix advice for vulnerabilities and supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests.

text: Slash commands (/snyk-fix, /snyk-batch-fix) in a coding assistant scan a project and auto-fix one or multiple vulnerabilities
quote: Run `/snyk-fix` in your coding assistant to scan the project and apply a fix for the top vulnerability. Use `/snyk-batch-fix` to address multiple issues at once.

text: Snyk MCP Server runs locally using the Snyk CLI to enable local file access for agents
quote: The Snyk MCP Server is designed as a local MCP server, running on your system using the Snyk CLI to ensure local file access.

text: Real-time code scanning integrates with IDEs, CLI, and source code managers (PR/commit checks)
